messages:
Maria: Hey team — PR #9123 is ready for review but blocked on architecture sign-off. RFC here: https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfcs/24 — it includes the rollout plan. Need arch + release coordination to pick a merge slot. Any objections to the approach?

Kevin: pinging @Jonathan and the arch folks for eyes. My immediate blocker question: how should the runtime behave when Dedicated capacity is constrained — fallback to a cheaper variant or queue? Need an explicit policy in the RFC.

Sylvia: skimmed the RFC. overall +1 on the design. One ask: can we extend the canary window to 48h? KV cache churn makes short canaries risky for this change.

Jonathan: thanks for the ping. I have two quick asks before I can sign off: (1) add a perf table with p95/p50/avg latency pre/post for the affected models, (2) include an estimated cost delta per 1M tokens. After that I can give formal arch approval.

Maria: ok will add perf numbers + cost estimates. Note that the PR touches batching defaults and prefix cache flags — I'll add a short note in the RFC linking the config diffs. Updating now, should be done in ~30m.

ci-bot: CI status — PR #9123: all checks passed ✅ (unit tests, integration tests, lint). Build: 3124.

Kevin: one more piece — release window. Next deploy slot is Fri 03:00 UTC. We'd need arch sign-off by Thu EOD to land and kick off canary. Is that workable?

Sylvia: Fri slot works for infra and SRE if sign-off is Thu. Also recommending a staged rollout: 5% for first 12h, then 25% for remainder of canary. I'll add that to the RFC comments.

Jonathan: I'll prioritize the review. Once Maria posts the perf table I'll do a pass — aim to finish by Thu 15:00 UTC.

Maria: updated RFC with a perf table and a cost row, plus a short snippet showing the batching config diff. Linked PR -> RFC in the PR description: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9123 — please review and thumbs-up if everything looks good.

Kevin: :thumbsup:

Sylvia: :+1:

Jonathan: Approved — arch sign-off granted. Go for Fri slot assuming no late blockers.

Maria: thanks all. I'll plan to merge Fri 03:00 UTC and run a 6h post-merge watch on the canary routes. Will post a brief rollup after the watch window.
